idea-plugin.name: Copy Code Reference with Line Numbers
idea-plugin.description:
Copy Code Reference with Line Numbers

A lightweight, productivity-boosting plugin that lets you copy file paths combined with selected line numbers in the format relative/path/to/file:startLine~endLine.

How to Use:

  1. Select any block of code inside the editor.
  2. Right-click to open the context menu and select Copy Code Reference (Line Numbers), or press Shift + Alt + C.
  3. The reference link is copied to your clipboard.

Example Reference:

src/main/java/com/example/copycodereference/CopyCodeReferenceAction.java:18~57
